title: iberis linifolia subsp. welwitschii
intro: Iberis linifolia subsp. welwitschii, commonly known as Welwitschia rosea or rock rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Iberis linifolia subsp. welwitschii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including the reduction of inflammation and the modulation of the immune system.
